text: Staff will bring forward to the July 4, 2018 Scarborough Community Council meeting a Final Report on the Zoning By-law Amendment application for 8861 Sheppard Avenue East. The zoning by-law amendment applications propose to amend the zoning by-law to establish appropriate development standards for a permitted 343 m2 place of worship and to bring this site into the City-wide Zoning By-law No. 569-2013 under the Institutional Place of Worship (IPW) Zone to permit a place of worship. To allow for the place of worship a Lift of Hold application has also been submitted to lift the holding provision with respect to the infrastructure required to service the site. Draft amending zoning by-laws are being reviewed and finalized to form attachments to the Final Report.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Withdrew the item from the Agenda as the requirement for the applicant to post notice of the application on the subject site was not fulfilled.
